stories.story_fr: Intel a lance ses premiers produits sur le procede 18A, presente comme la technologie de gravure la plus avancee developpee et fabriquee aux Etats-Unis, et accelere la montee en capacite face a une forte demande client (ER T4 2025).
stories.story_en: Intel introduced its first products on Intel 18A, described as the most advanced process technology developed and manufactured in the United States, and is ramping supply to meet strong customer demand (Q4 2025 ER).
stories.signal: The introduction of our first products on Intel 18A the most advanced process technology developed and manufactured in the United States marks an important milestone

stories.story_fr: Au T3 2025, Intel a renforce son bilan via un financement accelere du gouvernement americain et des investissements de NVIDIA et de SoftBank Group, signe du role critique d'Intel dans l'ecosysteme du calcul.
stories.story_en: In Q3 2025, Intel strengthened its balance sheet through accelerated US Government funding and investments by NVIDIA and SoftBank Group, underscoring its critical role in the compute ecosystem.
stories.signal: accelerated funding from the U.S. Government and investments by NVIDIA and SoftBank Group that increase our operational flexibility

stories.story_fr: La demande de silicium depasse l'offre disponible : Intel affiche un sixieme trimestre consecutif de revenu au-dessus de ses attentes et annonce une offre disponible au plus bas au T1 avant amelioration des le T2 (ER T1 2026 et T4 2025).
stories.story_en: Demand for silicon is outpacing supply: Intel posted a sixth consecutive quarter of revenue above expectations and flagged available supply at its lowest in Q1 before improving in Q2 (Q1 2026 and Q4 2025 ER).
stories.signal: a sixth consecutive quarter of revenue above our expectations
